purpose: Required future observations for one exact application image and an independently selected backend; this profile records no successful observations or compatibility.

requires: Run the exact independently authenticated application image digest and retain its source, runtime context and output inventory identities.
Read /marty-web-routes.json and match its source, application surface and route contract to the original receipt.
Observe organizationCreationEnabled: false by default and explicit true and false values selected through ORGANIZATION_CREATION_ENABLED.

Confirm runtime-config.js contains no secrets; its production hook injects GA and organization creation settings only. The separate GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION HTML injection is not runtime configuration.
Do not assume customer UI_ENABLED_SECTIONS or hosting configuration can be injected through the production hook.
Observe same-origin GET /v1/auth/me with cookies and no-store caching.
Treat explicit HTTP 401 or authenticated=false as unauthenticated; authenticated=true must include a valid principal.
Observe network failure, unavailable service and malformed responses preserving an existing session and exposing bounded Retry.
GET /v1/auth/provider is required, including when an external identity provider disables optional capabilities.
Observe provider_mode equal to keycloak or external, a nonempty provider_name, and Boolean registration_supported, passkey_enrollment_supported and provider_logout_supported.
Validate any account and recovery URLs as HTTPS URLs without embedded credentials.
Exercise /v1/auth/login?redirect_uri=/console&ui_locales=en through a real identity provider and /v1/auth/callback.
Observe the authenticated cookie session surviving browser refresh and POST /v1/auth/logout clearing it.
Exercise registration and provider logout according to the declared provider capabilities; do not infer support from successful startup.
POST /v1/auth/passkeys/enroll must exist and return the appropriate authenticated response or explicit unsupported capability response.
Observe a successful passkey enrollment ceremony only when passkey_enrollment_supported is true; a missing route never counts as unsupported capability handling.

Observe GET /v1/auth/me/organizations and protected read-only GET /v1/organizations/{id}, checking the expected organization identity and access, plus actual SDK WASM initialization against the selected backend.
Verify the selected backend services and OpenBao image digests without replacing its original UI image in the retained lock.
